== English errata comparison ==
The comparison retains the original English wording and Decipher's complete Glossary replacement. The pilot bonus changes from “any starship” to “anything”; all other clauses, printed statistics and uniqueness remain unchanged.<ref>[[:File:Dagobah-D-zuckuss-decipher-archive.gif|Original printed face]]; [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), PDF page 142, Zuckuss.</ref> Later repetition of the same wording remains the same text state. Reprints, translations and Virtual cards remain in Versions.
